summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration 5 regressions. Both CRITICAL bugs from iteration 5 are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) FarmerDashboard now mounts cleanly with wallet-hero, 'Funds protected until delivery is confirmed' text, hot-demand-strip, farmer-recs, stat-earnings-week, stat-active-orders, stat-pending-offers all rendering; (2) /explore renders the full React tree (explore-page testid, 6 listing cards, RatingPill + DeliveryBadge on every card via ProductCard). ProductRecommendations on /app/marketplace/:id now shows recs-same-region (country_code=NG backfill works). All spot checks pass: BuyerHome, Wallet deposit/withdraw drawers, and Promote-with-Video navigation with ?crop= prefill banner.

Consider adding recs-same-crop tiles by seeding >=2 listings per crop (currently only Cocoa, Maize, Cassava, Tomato, Yam each have a single listing — so recs-same-crop remains empty even though recs-same-region now renders).

server.py still >2600 lines; Phase B insights/recommendations should be split into routers/.
ProductCard uses testIdPrefix pattern consistently — good. RatingPill/DeliveryBadge correctly forward testId. No change needed.
